extDesc.message: Get instant push notifications when your long web tasks, AI generations, and terminal scripts finish. No account required!

tooltip_text.message:
Pair your device by scanning the QR code from the mobile app or entering the CLI terminal code.

You can teach Mample which button to track by typing /mample on any website or clicking Select Key in the extension. Once trained, simply type /mample after starting a process, and Mample will send you a notification when the button disappears.

If you check the Get Notifications from Selected Key option (Auto Mode) in the extension, you don't need to type /mample every time; you'll receive an automatic notification whenever that button disappears.

You can manage and delete your trained sites using the ☰ menu.

More info: mample.vercel.app
